name: weekly-team-report
description: Every Monday, posts to Slack what the team created, changed and published last week, compared with the week before, with the work that is still waiting.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every Monday at 9:00 in your time zone

howItWorks.label: Counts
howItWorks.text: Records created, changed and published last week, per type, against the week before

howItWorks.label: Credits
howItWorks.text: Who did the work, when your records keep an author or owner

howItWorks.label: Lists
howItWorks.text: Drafts and records still waiting, oldest first

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short report to your Slack channel

plugins.reason: Posts the weekly report to your team's channel

data.description: The record types the team works on (products, articles, pages, orders…), each with its _createdAt and _updatedAt timestamps
Who created or owns a record (author, owner, assignee), when the schema keeps one

When a record was published, when the schema keeps it
